content.text:
**Context:** Extending the Baylor GPS PlayerLoad-band analysis (`DataBase_GPS_Reporting/analysis/pl_bands`): Codex review of the new code, then position benchmarks/tiers, season comparisons and game demands.

**Key Exchanges:**
- User asked for a Codex review of three commits (period view, face parser, heavy-workload roster; base `c7ec998`). Five rounds ran: 16 findings, all fixed.
- User asked for (1) position-group benchmark tiers, (2) team 2025 vs 2026, (3) camp-to-now trend in 2026, (4) game-by-game demands. Built as `benchmarks_view.py`; outputs `position_benchmarks.csv`, `athlete_tiers.csv`, `game_demands.csv` in `gps_report/data/pl_bands/`. Last commit `70dda92`, pushed.
- Results:
  - 2026 median practice High-Load s/hr by position: DL 70 (2025: 22.5), CB 54, WR 48, S 47 (2025: 29), RB 45, OLB 41, LB 34 (2025: 44.5), TE 31, OL 30, QB 16. Tiers: 91 athletes, 28 High, 39 Mid, 24 Low.
  - Team trend: 2026 camp 45–49, in-season 39–45, latest (UCF week) 33.7. 2025 camp 31–35, climbed to 37–41 late. 2026 started hot and is declining; 2025 rose late.
  - Games: all about 2.8–3.3 High-Load s per snap. 2026 vs 2025: DL 3.75 vs 2.90, CB 2.13 vs 2.67, OL 1.98 vs 1.66.

**Decisions Made:**
- Rename "physicality" to **"High-Load Time"** (seconds above PlayerLoad 2.0), because PlayerLoad bands capture all hard movement, not just contact.
- Tiers: High ≥ P75, Low < P25, Mid between, computed within each position. Within-position percentile enables cross-position comparison. Requires at least 3 weeks of data (weeks 2 to latest).
- Camp split into camp weeks, then game weeks in-season, so a week never spans two games.
- Roster compares the same weeks for 2025 and 2026.
- Each output records its build fingerprint, and views refuse to print on mismatched inputs.

**Lessons Learned:**
- PFF game times are in UTC; convert to Baylor local time to match Catapult sessions (all 19 PFF games then matched by date).
- Tempo labels from the offense script apply only to offensive players, so the tempo table counts offense only. Rates: Team full speed 0.98 vs unlabeled 0.49; Teach full speed 0.47, run-thru 0.25, unlabeled 0.17.
- Game "per snap" is slightly inflated, since band time includes warm-ups and special teams. Compare game to game, not game to practice.
- Changing the fingerprint formula forces a full re-pull of periods. Cache reuse works (the second run re-pulled 0 sessions).

**Action Items:**
- Codex has not reviewed the round 5 fixes or `benchmarks_view.py`.
- Parse the face defense tabs so tempo labels cover defensive players.
- The UCF Week 09 face is missing, so last week has no tempo labels. PFF has games through week 8; UCF comes with Wednesday's pull.
- Add `openpyxl` to `requirements.txt` (it is in the venv only).
